about: Golden images due to be written for the first time or written again, and not looked at yet: a new scene, or a picture a change made on purpose redraws. A picture named here is still drawn, saved to Saved/DreamGUITests/Captures and compared with its golden when there is one, but a missing golden or a difference is a warning that gives the reason here, never a failure (FDreamPixelProbe::GetPendingGoldenReason).
To clear an entry: run the test with -DreamGUIWriteGoldens on the editor's command line, look at the golden it wrote, and take the entry out. From then on the picture is held to it again.

The goldens named <scene>_SmallTextCoverageOff are the pictures the scenes draw with the small-text switch off, from the distance field at every size. They were copies of the pictures from before small-text coverage until the multisampled target took the render target's sRGB flag, which redraws them like every other multisampled picture.
